user_query: I'm a music enthusiast and I want to explore the greatest adult pop songs of all time. Can you provide me with the chart information and the genre details of these songs? Also, fetch the song details and comments for the top 10 songs on the Billboard Global 200 chart from last year.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of greatest adult pop songs of all time along with their chart information and genre details.
Fetch the top 10 songs from the Billboard Global 200 chart from last year.
Fetch the song details and comments for the top 10 songs obtained in subtask 2.
